g.title: j1667564724
g.text: I think I have something that can help you.

g.title: j3806963563
g.text: There's this place I know, I guess where I'm from actually. Duviri.

g.title: j2840134470
g.text: And it's still there, even though I'm gone. In the Void.

g.title: j1690797708
g.text: And the system where the other kid is, it's a place I've been.

g.title: j113317073
g.text: Mhmm, all your footsteps really are the key to me 'following safely, you know.'

g.title: j3630121464
g.text: Boolean KayaFutureWin1 is now true.

g.title: j1033458962
g.text: It's like a big glowing Voidy Exit sign, when it comes to particles being attracted to their next form.

g.title: j3380003096
g.text: Sorry um right, but what is 'Duviri'? A state of matter?

g.title: j2079929311
g.text: It's a place I created in the Void.

g.title: j4248425510
g.text: In many ways it's my true home. Where I... grew up.

g.title: j3688910387
g.text: Filled with embodiments of concepts, emotions.

g.title: j3579964858
g.text: It's in the Void.

g.title: j1970192946
g.text: It's basically a 'textbook' come to life.

g.title: j4091355796
g.text: We don't get a lot of visitors these days, though.

g.title: j2769965762
g.text: Haha! Omg. Ok I see, and it is firmly in the Void?

g.title: j3669170009
g.text: Roll out the red Carpet in case I show up.

g.title: j2034672051
g.text: It is, but it's very much buoyed to the Zariman.

g.title: j184437257
g.text: I don't go back there often...

g.title: j2763689163
g.text: Do you really think you'll go there?

g.title: j114469713
g.text: On it, space traveler! [End.]

g.title: j1065374515
g.text: Like a big, metal Moon.

g.title: j1323669493
g.text: Is it even still there? How can you be sure?

g.title: j2333948044
g.text: Plan for all potential outcomes.

g.title: j392027042
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j726470065
g.text: Is there a sun?

g.title: j2485866587
g.text: I think so? I would know if it disappeared if I left.

g.title: j1739831959
g.text: What about the outcome if you get lost somewhere, somewhen?

g.title: j61864645
g.text: I don't mind entertaining all this, but do you really think you'll find a way out of 1999?

j4078333519
g.text: Think hard enough about one and maybe?

g.title: j2627710728
g.text: I was being poetic, there's no Sun.

g.title: j3115862661
g.text: Would you? There's a school of science that might expect the observation of Duviri to be key to its existence.

g.title: j2146955841
g.text: IDK, say something nice at my funeral if you never see me again.

g.title: j2611824742
g.text: Yup, and let me know if you can help!

g.title: j1298416699
g.text: Ha, ha.

g.title: j2037915159
g.text: Any celestial objects?

g.title: j1613915451
g.text: I'm not sure that science could explain this. 'It' is the cause of all of this.

g.title: j2224956106
g.text: That sounds more like philosophy.

g.title: j2253494591
g.text: Oh and tell Arthur I think he's cute, but only if I am like really gone.

g.title: j2504254877
g.text: I'll try.

g.title: j912679707
g.text: Not that I know of.

g.title: j3014399365
g.text: Nope.

g.title: j1422368624
g.text: Do you think 'It' can be explained?

g.title: j2369583525
g.text: Not my highest mark, don't remind me, ugh.

g.title: j1487584150
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j4171633198
g.text: All things in the known universe are defined by their relation to celestial bodies. How odd, this Void.

g.title: j4143016201
g.text: I don't know that I want it to.

g.title: j1377562662
g.text: If 'It' Could, we'd solve a lot of problems.

g.title: j3767162640
g.text: You struggle with Philosophy?

g.title: j4221547686
g.text: Despite the circumstances... if it comes to that, I will.

g.title: j877433719
g.text: It's 'The Void'. Nothing until there's something.

g.title: j1046211793
g.text: When we find Albrecht, we'll have to take him back there or something. I don't really have a plan yet.

g.title: j2588987976
g.text: Well, for your sake I guess it'd be kinda fun to answer your Scientific enigma, I hope you get answers.

g.title: j3143685087
g.text: I guess? Maybe not like, 'struggle' exactly. Who cares about why and who, let's just make cool things.

g.text: Thankkk youuu!

g.text: Meh.

g.title: j547775926
g.text: Wellll seems related but not my focus of studies. See ya if I see ya!

g.title: j2197697362
g.text: I'm not sure I'll like the answers, Nova.

g.text: Me too, one day.

g.title: j1603047685
g.text: I guess, but you're sharing this planet with others, our choices impact others whether we like it or not.

g.title: j1442502293
g.text: Maybe that's what Entrati thought before he went into the Void the first time, now look at us.
